availability: Free · macOS 15 or later · requires LedgeKit API 0.24.0 (newer than Ledge Beta 10)
description: Translate text where you read or write it. Select up to 4,000 characters in another app and press the shortcut you choose in Quick Translate settings. A black card beside the selection shows the language direction, an On this Mac badge, the translation, Copy (⌘C), Replace (Return) and Close (Escape). Choose a target language and a second language for text already in your target language. Turn on the optional button beside mouse selections if you prefer to click. Ledge uses Apple Translation for supported language pairs; macOS may ask to download language files. Requires Accessibility. Secure fields are excluded, and a changed or read-only selection is copied instead of edited. No selected or translated text is saved, sent to the add-on, or sent to an AI or online translation provider. Unsupported pairs show a message; there is no AI fallback.
